summary: Completed testing of Khurpi Microgreens settings system - Shop config, delivery pricing, subscription plans. All backend APIs pass (16/16). Frontend UI verified for Admin Settings, Subscription Plans, and Footer address.
critical_code_review_comments: All settings APIs working correctly with proper validation
Distance-based delivery pricing using Haversine formula is accurate
Subscription plans with discounts (5%, 10%, 25%) displayed correctly
Shop address (E-312, ACE City, Noida Extension, 201306) shown in Footer and Admin Settings
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings system fully tested. Backend APIs: GET /api/settings/shop, /api/settings/delivery-pricing, /api/settings/subscription-plans, POST /api/settings/calculate-delivery-fee all working. Admin can update settings via PUT endpoints. Frontend: Admin Settings page shows all 3 sections (Shop Config, Delivery Pricing, Subscription Plans). Subscription Create page shows plans with correct discounts (5%, 10%, 25%). Footer shows correct shop address.

settings_apis.GET /api/settings/shop: Returns shop config with name, address (E-312, ACE City, Noida Extension, 201306), coordinates (28.5672, 77.4538)
settings_apis.GET /api/settings/subscription-plans: Returns 3 plans: Weekly 5%, Twice Weekly 10%, Daily 25%
settings_apis.POST /api/settings/calculate-delivery-fe: Calculates fee based on distance using Haversine formula

admin_settings_page.shop_configuration: Displays and allows editing of shop name, address, coordinates, phone, email
admin_settings_page.delivery_pricing: Shows 4 tiers with max distance, fee, and label - editable
admin_settings_page.subscription_plans: Shows 3 plans with id, name, frequency, deliveries/week, discount - editable

subscription_create_page.step_2_choose_plan: Shows all 3 plans with correct discounts and BEST VALUE badge for 25% plan

footer.shop_address: E-312, ACE City, Noida Extension, 201306 - correctly displayed

mocked_apis_note: Phone/OTP authentication uses password instead. Razorpay payments use Cash on Delivery.
